'''Heavy Carriers''' are a [[Mobs|Mob]] in the [[Inborn Parasites|Inborn]] Tier.

== ''Spawning'' ==
*Spawned by [[Stage III Beckon|Stage III Beckons]].
*Spawns from [[Evolution Phases|Phase 2]] to [[Evolution Phases|Phase 4]] with spawnweight of 2.

== ''Behavior'' ==
Heavy Carriers are Large Infestation Propagators that hold other infectors and combatants.

* Heavy Carriers will explode when they get close to the entity they are targeting or upon death (assuming they are not on fire). 
** This explosion can spawn several mobs ([[Heavy Carrier#Carrier Mob Contents|More Info Below]]), place [[Residue]] in a 13x13 area, and will inflict the [[Viral]] effect.
** The area where they exploded will spawn the aforementioned Mobs together with a Poison and [[Call Of The Hive|COTH]] Cloud<ref>This unique effect cloud is known in the mod as "srparasites:cloudtoxic."</ref>.

* Heavy Carriers are able to traverse faster in liquids by performing small leaps.
{{Variants|count=1|Empty=EmptyHeavyCarrier.png}}

=== ''Weaknesses'' ===

* Heavy Carriers, like any other [[Mobs|Mob]], present a weakness to Fire. Damage inflicted by Fire is quadrupled.
* Heavy Carriers on fire will not explode and release anything upon death.

|tier=Inborn
